card.title: Huawei P30 Pro Does not recognize sim card (No sim out of nowhere) Repair

source.title: Huawei P30 Pro Does not recognize sim card (No sim out of nowhere) Repair

claims.statement: On Huawei P30 Pro the SIM tray daughterboard connects through the charging port flex; pins break off its connectors, causing sudden 'no SIM'. Replace the flex after clearing broken pin remnants from the connector.

procedure: Inspect both flex connectors for broken pins.
Remove pin residue from the connector.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
